domains.name: Search Content Decisions
domains.scope: Plan and improve search-oriented content using intent, page purpose, evidence gaps, and editorial constraints.

domains.name: Search Site Architecture
domains.scope: Plan search-oriented navigation, page relationships, and site-change reviews using supplied inventories and implementation constraints.

domains.name: Local Search Operations
domains.scope: Prepare accurate local business information, location content, and review-response workflows without assuming platform eligibility or ranking outcomes.

domains.name: Marketing Measurement Decisions
domains.scope: Define and interpret marketing measures using explicit denominators, attribution limits, comparison conditions, and decision-linked reporting.

domains.name: Customer and Market Research
domains.scope: Design and synthesize customer research using explicit recruitment, question design, evidence coding, and decision boundaries.

domains.name: Campaign Planning and Review
domains.scope: Prepare campaign briefs, channel coordination, creative tests, and launch reviews around defined audiences and measurable objectives.

domains.name: Lifecycle Email Planning
domains.scope: Design and review email journeys using explicit audience eligibility, message purpose, consent evidence, and operational checks.

domains.name: Commercial Brand and Editorial
domains.scope: Develop and review commercial messaging, editorial briefs, and reusable brand language using supported claims and observable style choices.

domains.name: Sales Process Enablement
domains.scope: Prepare sales discovery, qualification, demonstrations, follow-up drafts, and handoffs using verified customer context and bounded commitments.

domains.name: E-commerce Customer Experience
domains.scope: Review catalog, product, cart, checkout, and post-purchase experiences using verified offer and fulfillment facts.

domains.name: Product Experience Review
domains.scope: Review product flows, interface content, prototypes, and feedback using user tasks and observable acceptance criteria.

domains.name: Startup Customer Validation
domains.scope: Plan customer validation experiments and evidence reviews without treating interest, prototypes, or founder enthusiasm as proven demand.

domains.name: Startup Operating Workflows
domains.scope: Define lightweight service delivery, support, vendor, and internal handoff workflows for small organizations.

domains.name: Fiction Scene Craft
domains.scope: Draft and revise individual fictional scenes through viewpoint, action, dialogue, sensory selection, and meaningful changes in character circumstances.

domains.name: Fiction Story Structure
domains.scope: Develop and revise story-level causal sequences, character decisions, reveals, subplots, and endings through concrete beat outlines.

domains.name: Photography Planning and Critique
domains.scope: Plan and critique photographs through subject intention, framing, light, visual sequence, and shoot logistics without fixed equipment recipes.

domains.name: Visual Composition and Art Direction
domains.scope: Develop and critique visual compositions through hierarchy, grouping, contrast, typography, image relationships, and concrete art-direction briefs.
